summary: Silexion Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting an inducement letter with holders of 3,216,928 Series E warrants, who agreed to cash-exercise at a reduced $0.2603 per share for roughly $0.84 million gross proceeds. In exchange, the company will issue Series F and Series G warrants for up to 6,433,856 ordinary shares at the same exercise price, plus 225,185 placement agent warrants. H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent for a 7.0% cash fee and 1.0% management fee. The transaction extends equity overhang and highlights liquidity needs for the clinical-stage biotech, with dilution risks for existing shareholders.
